name: c-button-group-1
title: Basic button group with two buttons
label: Two Buttons
description: Basic button group with two buttons

guidance.bestFor: The minimal join: 2 outline text buttons sharing one seam, with no icons, menus or handlers

whenNotToUse.when: Filled primary buttons divided by thin tinted rules

name: c-button-group-2
title: Button group with button followed by input
label: Button & Input
description: Button group with button followed by input

guidance.bestFor: An outline button fused to the left end of a plain text field, the smallest control and field pair
agentNotes: The `Input` has no label, only a `placeholder` that disappears once typing starts; add a visible label

whenNotToUse.when: A search field with a leading icon and a menu trigger at its end

name: c-button-group-3
title: Button group with buttons and badge
label: Buttons & Badge
description: Button group with buttons and badge

guidance.bestFor: Mixed content in one strip: a file icon with a Draft badge, an Edit button with text and an icon only upload
agentNotes: The upload `Button` is icon only with no accessible name; add a label for screen readers

name: c-button-group-4
title: Button group with dropdown menu
label: Dropdown Menu
description: Button group with dropdown menu

guidance.bestFor: An Update action beside a chevron menu of Production, Staging and Development deploy targets
agentNotes: The chevron `DropdownMenuTrigger` wraps an icon only `Button` with no accessible name; label it

whenNotToUse.when: A list of choices opened from one trigger with no main action beside it

name: c-button-group-5
title: Team activity and collaboration group
label: Team Activity
description: Team activity and collaboration group

guidance.bestFor: A team presence strip: Team button, 3 stacked avatars with a 3 Live dot, plus and clock icons and a settings menu
agentNotes: Replace `team`, whose avatars load from github.com, with your members; the 3 Live label is fixed text
The plus, clock and overflow `Button` elements are icon only and have no accessible names; label each

name: c-button-group-6
title: Button group using icons for visual actions
label: Icon Actions
description: Button group using icons for visual actions

guidance.bestFor: Icon only flip horizontal, flip vertical and rotate tools, with no text on any of them
agentNotes: None of the 3 `Button` elements has an accessible name; add a label to each, as `c-button-group-12` does

name: c-button-group-7
title: Dropdown menu with status indicator
label: Status Indicator
description: Dropdown menu with status indicator

guidance.bestFor: A deploy status strip: a branch menu with main checked, a pulsing Production dot, then refresh and open icons
agentNotes: The refresh and external link `Button` elements are icon only with no accessible names; label both

name: c-button-group-8
title: Button group styled as a like button with a counter
label: Like Counter
description: Button group styled as a like button with a counter

guidance.bestFor: A Like action with a heart icon fused to a 1.2K count styled as a matching outline cell
agentNotes: The 1.2K count is a `Button` rendered as a `span`, yet on base it still gets a button role and a tab stop; show static counts in `ButtonGroupText`

name: c-button-group-9
title: Nested button groups for complex action sets
label: Nested Groups
description: Nested button groups for complex action sets

guidance.bestFor: Nested groups that set an icon only send button apart from a message field with a Voice Mode tooltip addon
agentNotes: Each inner `ButtonGroup` is a direct child of the outer one, so the 2 render apart with a gap instead of joined
The send `Button` is icon only and has no accessible name; label it before shipping

name: c-button-group-10
title: Button group used for standard pagination
label: Basic Pagination
description: Button group used for standard pagination

guidance.bestFor: Previous and Next text buttons with arrows around small page numbers 1 to 3, none marked as current

whenNotToUse.when: Page navigation that needs real links, an ellipsis and a marked current page

name: c-button-group-11
title: Pagination split into page numbers and navigation arrows
label: Split Pagination
description: Pagination split into page numbers and navigation arrows

guidance.bestFor: Icon only arrows hugging small page numbers 1 to 3, with all 5 buttons nested in one inner group
agentNotes: All 5 buttons share one inner `ButtonGroup`, so nothing is split; give the arrows their own groups to set them apart
The 2 arrow `Button` elements are icon only with no accessible names; label them Previous and Next

name: c-button-group-12
title: Button group for editor text alignment controls
label: Text Alignment
description: Button group for editor text alignment controls

guidance.bestFor: Left, center, right and justify alignment as small icon buttons, each named for screen readers
agentNotes: None of the 4 `Button` elements keeps the chosen alignment; add state and shade the active one

whenNotToUse.when: Alignment where exactly one choice stays pressed and is announced as such

name: c-button-group-13
title: Vertical button group orientation
label: Vertical Orientation
description: Vertical button group orientation

guidance.bestFor: A vertical pair of named add and subtract icon buttons stacked into one column

name: c-button-group-14
title: Nested vertical button group for complex tool palettes
label: Vertical Tool Palette
description: Nested vertical button group for complex tool palettes

guidance.bestFor: A vertical tool palette of search, copy and share icons, with delete held apart in its own group below

name: c-button-group-15
title: Star button group with count and dropdown
label: Star With Dropdown
description: Star button group with count and dropdown

guidance.bestFor: A repository Star action with a 2.4k badge and a chevron menu from Watch and Fork down to Report

name: c-button-group-16
title: Search input with filter menu and clear button
label: Search Filter Clear
description: Search input with filter menu and clear button

guidance.bestFor: A record filter bar: a Filter scope menu, a plain search field and an X button at the end
agentNotes: The X `Button` has no handler and the `Input` keeps its own value, so nothing clears; wire both to your filter state
The clear `Button` is icon only and unnamed; give it a label such as Clear filter

whenNotToUse.when: A search field whose icon and clear control sit inside its own border

name: c-button-group-17
title: Button group with comprehensive action menu
label: Conversation Menu
description: Button group with comprehensive action menu

guidance.bestFor: A Conversation button with a kebab menu of 6 thread actions above a red Delete Conversation item
agentNotes: The kebab `DropdownMenuTrigger` renders an icon only `Button` with no accessible name; add one

name: c-button-group-18
title: Advanced git toolbar with branch selection and split commit button
label: Git Split Button
description: Advanced git toolbar with branch selection and split commit button

guidance.bestFor: A filled Execute split with a play icon and a chevron menu to commit and push, sync or amend

whenNotToUse.when: A toolbar that also picks the branch and shows the deploy target

name: c-button-group-19
title: Button group with dropdown menu and input group
label: Search With Menu
description: Button group with dropdown menu and input group

guidance.bestFor: A search field with a leading magnifier icon and an icon only kebab menu of record scopes at its end

whenNotToUse.when: A labeled primary trigger after the field rather than a kebab icon

name: c-button-group-20
title: Button group with input group and button
label: Search With Button
description: Button group with input group and button

guidance.bestFor: A search field ending in a filled primary Search button that opens a menu of record scopes
agentNotes: The Search `Button` is the `DropdownMenuTrigger`, so it opens the scope menu and never submits the query

name: c-button-group-21
title: Button group with dropdown menu and input group
label: File Name Menu
description: Button group with dropdown menu and input group

guidance.bestFor: A file name field with a leading file icon and a plus menu to create a file, folder or workspace
agentNotes: The plus trigger carries `aria-label` Filter, which misnames a create menu; rename it to match

name: c-button-group-22
title: Basic button group with disabled button
label: Disabled Button
description: Basic button group with disabled button

guidance.bestFor: Files, Folder and Trash text buttons with icons, where the middle one is disabled and dimmed

name: c-button-group-23
title: Button group buttons with separators
label: Separated Buttons
description: Button group buttons with separators

guidance.bestFor: Filled primary Files, Folder and Media buttons with borders stripped, split by tinted separators
agentNotes: The Media `Button` keeps `aria-label` Trash, so screen readers announce the wrong name; correct it

whenNotToUse.when: Outline buttons that touch directly with no dividing rule

name: c-button-group-24
title: View switcher for dashboard layouts
label: Dashboard Views
description: View switcher for dashboard layouts

guidance.bestFor: Grid, list and table view icons named for screen readers, with no current view tracked or shaded

whenNotToUse.when: A view switch that remembers and shades the chosen layout

name: c-button-group-25
title: Rating scale using numerical buttons
label: Rating Scale
description: Rating scale using numerical buttons

guidance.bestFor: A 1 to 10 likelihood scale with Not likely and Very likely end labels, the picked score filled
agentNotes: The score lives in local `rating` state and is never submitted; send it from `setRating` to your survey

name: c-button-group-26
title: Button group with user selection select
label: User Selection
description: Button group with user selection select

guidance.bestFor: A team member Select with avatar and name in its trigger, joined to add tag and settings icons
agentNotes: Replace `users`, whose avatars load from images.unsplash.com, with your team members

name: c-button-group-27
title: Button group with select status addon
label: Status Select
description: Button group with select status addon

guidance.bestFor: A status Select with colored dots, preset to Completed, joined to a task search field
agentNotes: Each entry in `statuses` sets its dot with a Tailwind class in `color`; swap in your workflow states

name: c-button-group-28
title: Volume controller with plus/minus actions
label: Volume Control
description: Volume controller with plus/minus actions

guidance.bestFor: A volume stepper moving in steps of 5 from 0 to 100, whose middle readout toggles mute on click
agentNotes: `volume` and `isMuted` exist only in local state; connect them to your audio element

whenNotToUse.when: A readout that only shows the level and cannot be clicked

name: c-button-group-29
title: Button group with follower count
label: Follower Count
description: Button group with follower count

guidance.bestFor: An outline Follow action with a user plus icon and a muted 2.4k followers caption beside it

name: c-button-group-30
title: Active state button group with count
label: Active Count
description: Active state button group with count

guidance.bestFor: A filled Star action whose 2.4k count sits in a text cell outlined in the primary color
agentNotes: The Star `Button` carries `aria-label` Following 2.4k, which overrides its visible Star text

name: c-button-group-31
title: Horizontal button group with primary and secondary labels
label: Share Caption
description: Horizontal button group with primary and secondary labels

guidance.bestFor: A filled Share action trailed by a 128 Shares caption on a transparent, tightly padded text cell

name: c-button-group-32
title: Button group with dropdown menu and view toggle
label: Sort & View
description: Button group with dropdown menu and view toggle

guidance.bestFor: A sort icon menu, a grid or list pair and a filled Add New menu in one row, with only the view pair joined
agentNotes: `view` only moves the `bg-muted` shade between the 2 buttons; render your grid or list from it

whenNotToUse.when: A 2 way view choice whose pressed option must reach screen readers

name: c-button-group-33
title: Button group with select controls
label: Select Controls
description: Button group with select controls

guidance.bestFor: Joined environment and time range Selects, the range list split into recent and Observability Plus groups
agentNotes: `env` and `range` feed only the 2 Select values; pass them to your metrics query

name: c-button-group-34
title: Segmented control with dropdown inside button group
label: Segmented Control
description: Segmented control with dropdown inside button group

guidance.bestFor: Routes, Paths and Bot Name segments with icons, Paths shaded first, ending in a chevron options menu
agentNotes: The chevron `DropdownMenuTrigger` is icon only and unnamed; give its `Button` a label

whenNotToUse.when: Segments that each reveal their own panel of content below

name: c-button-group-35
title: Pagination button group
label: Numbered Pagination
description: Pagination button group

guidance.bestFor: Square page buttons 1 to 5 between chevrons, with page 3 filled to mark the current page
agentNotes: Page 3 is filled by a fixed `variant`; set it from your current page
The 2 chevron `Button` elements are icon only and lack accessible names; label them

whenNotToUse.when: Paged results with link based pages, ellipsis gaps and an announced current page

name: c-button-group-36
title: View switcher button group
label: View Switcher
description: View switcher button group

guidance.bestFor: List, grid and table view icons with the list view shaded as current by a fixed class
agentNotes: The `bg-muted` shade on List view is hardcoded; move it with your selected view state

name: c-button-group-37
title: Zoom controls button group
label: Zoom Controls
description: Zoom controls button group

guidance.bestFor: A zoom stepper of 10 percent steps between 10 and 200, the level shown in a fixed width text cell
agentNotes: `zoom` is local state; apply it to your canvas or viewer from `handleZoomIn` and `handleZoomOut`

name: c-button-group-38
title: Media player controls button group
label: Media Controls
description: Media player controls button group

guidance.bestFor: Skip back, play and skip forward transport icons, each named for screen readers, with no playback state
agentNotes: Play never turns into pause and no `Button` has a handler; wire them to your player

name: c-button-group-39
title: Split button with dropdown trigger
label: Split Button
description: Split button with dropdown trigger

guidance.bestFor: A filled Save split with a faint separator and a chevron menu to publish, keep a draft or exit

name: c-button-group-40
title: Vertical button group
label: Vertical List
description: Vertical button group

guidance.bestFor: A vertical list of 4 left aligned text items with no icons, Dashboard shaded as current
agentNotes: Dashboard keeps a hardcoded `bg-muted`; drive the shade from your current route

whenNotToUse.when: Navigation items with icons whose shade follows a click

name: c-button-group-41
title: Model selector with tier badges
label: Model Selector
description: Model selector with tier badges

guidance.bestFor: An AI model picker with icons, Fast, Pro and Preview badges and a context size tooltip per model
agentNotes: Replace `models` with yours; each entry carries its `badge`, `badgeVariant` and `tooltip` text

name: c-button-group-42
title: Segmented order type selector
label: Order Type
description: Segmented order type selector

guidance.bestFor: A trading order type picker for Market, Limit, Stop and Stop Limit, each with an explanatory tooltip
agentNotes: `active` only shades the chosen type with `bg-muted`; pass it to your order form

name: c-button-group-43
title: Buy sell hold toggle group
label: Buy Sell Hold
description: Buy sell hold toggle group

guidance.bestFor: Buy, Hold and Sell stances that fill when picked and clear on a second click, starting with none
agentNotes: `active` returns to null on a second click, so treat no stance as a valid value

whenNotToUse.when: A stance choice whose pressed option must be announced to assistive tech

name: c-button-group-44
title: Pipeline stage mover with dropdown
label: Pipeline Stage
description: Pipeline stage mover with dropdown

guidance.bestFor: A CRM stage stepper whose arrows disable at the ends around a Jump to stage menu with a check
agentNotes: Replace `stages`; `stageIndex` starts at 2, so it reads Proposal until you pass the record's stage

whenNotToUse.when: A progress tracker that lists every step with its completion state

name: c-button-group-45
title: Environment switcher with indicator
label: Environment Switcher
description: Environment switcher with indicator

guidance.bestFor: Dev, Staging and Production segments with tooltips, where a Live dot appears only while Production is on
agentNotes: `active` only shades a segment and shows the Live cell; connect it to your environment switch

name: c-button-group-46
title: Compact time interval selector
label: Time Interval
description: Compact time interval selector

guidance.bestFor: Compact time intervals from 1m to 1W plus Auto, on 28px tall buttons with small tabular text
agentNotes: `active` starts at 1H and only shades the chosen `interval`; feed it to your chart query

name: c-button-group-47
title: Review actions split button
label: Review Actions
description: Review actions split button

guidance.bestFor: A filled Approve split whose chevron menu offers approve with conditions, request changes or a red Reject

name: c-button-group-48
title: Toolbar filter with export and view toggle
label: Export Toolbar
description: Toolbar filter with export and view toggle

guidance.bestFor: One joined toolbar: Filter, Export CSV with a chevron for Excel, JSON and PDF, then a grid or list switch
agentNotes: `view` only shades the grid or list `Button`; render your layout from it

name: c-button-group-49
title: Vertical nav links with icons
label: Vertical Nav
description: Vertical nav links with icons

guidance.bestFor: A vertical nav of 4 icon and text items where a click moves the shaded highlight
agentNotes: Each item is a `Button` that sets `active`, not a link; render anchors when items change routes

name: c-button-group-50
title: Toolbar filter sort and more
label: Filter Sort More
description: Toolbar filter sort and more

guidance.bestFor: Small icon only Filter and Sort buttons, a default separator, then a More menu for link, share and export

name: c-button-group-51
title: New button with create dropdown
label: Create Menu
description: New button with create dropdown

guidance.bestFor: A small New button with a plus joined to a more menu that creates a customer, order or invoice
agentNotes: The `aria-label` More options belongs on the unnamed icon only menu trigger, not the New `Button` whose text it hides

name: c-button-group-52
title: Refresh share and export dropdown
label: Dashboard Actions
description: Refresh share and export dropdown

guidance.bestFor: Dashboard header actions: an icon only refresh, a Share button and a More menu to edit or export CSV or PNG

name: c-button-group-53
title: Publish controls with split button and overflow
label: Publish Controls
description: Publish controls with split button and overflow

guidance.bestFor: A publishing header row: 2 viewer avatars, a Preview button, a filled Publish split and a ghost overflow menu
agentNotes: Only Publish and its chevron sit in `ButtonGroup`; the avatars, Preview and overflow menu are a plain flex row
Replace `viewers`, whose avatars load from images.unsplash.com, with the people viewing the document
Below `md` the Preview `Button` hides its text and is left with no accessible name

name: c-button-group-54
title: API service environment and version selectors
label: Service Selectors
description: API service environment and version selectors

guidance.bestFor: Compact API service, environment and version menus joined in a row, the version set in monospace
agentNotes: Each trigger's `aria-label` replaces its visible value, so screen readers never hear the current pick
`service`, `environment` and `version` are local state; read them where you build the request

name: c-button-group-55
title: Payout release controls with amount context
label: Payout Release
description: Payout release controls with amount context

guidance.bestFor: A payout row: a USD 12,480 amount cell joined to Hold, beside a filled Release split with Cancel payout
agentNotes: The USD 12,480 amount is fixed text in `ButtonGroupText`; bind it to the payout record

name: c-button-group-56
title: Attachment button group with download action
label: File Attachment
description: Attachment button group with download action

guidance.bestFor: A file chip: paperclip, file name and size on an extra small button, joined to an icon only download
agentNotes: Replace `attachment` with your file record; the download `Button` has no handler yet

whenNotToUse.when: A file card in a chat reply or upload queue with type, size and status

name: c-button-group-57
title: Agent mode selector with credit cap dropdown
label: Agent Mode
description: Agent mode selector with credit cap dropdown

guidance.bestFor: Assist, Review and Auto agent modes, a default separator and a credit cap menu from 2k credits to Unlimited
agentNotes: `active` and `limit` are local state only; pass them to your agent run settings
